title: Violins in dance bands; Max Fink
summary: Dance bands rarely used violins; first with a violin was Pete Herman's Black Orchard with the Marco brothers; Max Fink was a straight violinist.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Did many of the dance bands have violins in them, most of them?

No, no dance bands. No violins at all. They didn't do it? All the dance bands that they had was just reed, brass, and string. I mean, it falls to bass, what do you call it? Yeah. But I mean, they didn't have the... But there was no such thing as violins or nothing. The first band that I played were a dance band that had a violin. That's when I tell you that I played at the Black Orchard, whose name the Black Orchard was Pete Hoyman's place. That's when we had Oscar Marco and his brother, Mickey Marco. You see? One played violin, the other one played...
But back in Jack Lane's days, he didn't use a violin... Well, yeah.

At one time, this fellow, the little guitar player, what they call him, little Joe Hernandez, he used to play a little violin himself, but mostly he played guitar. But it's very seldom that he used it. What about Watsky? He just used it now and then, you know what I mean?

What about Watsky? Did you ever know him? A violin player named Watsky? King, Watsky, got everybody to know him. He may have been uptown or something. No, I don't know. I think maybe Bud Lloyd Cannon told me about him or something. I'm not sure what I've been talking about. You know where I'm telling him.

Well, Dick, I might have... You see, this is the idea. I might have known him, but I just can't recollect the name, you see? I can't place the name. Sure, well, you never remember everybody's name. Because I've met so many and played with so many, I can't think of their names. You know what I mean?
Was Max Fink hot like Oscar Marco or was he more straight?
No, Max Fink was straight. And Max Fink had the most scientific G-string solo on his violin than anybody you ever heard in your life. I never heard a man play on a G-string on a violin like Max Fink.
Did he play in the theater here like the Art of Fame? Yeah, he played at the Liberty Theater. He played at the Little Club, didn't he?
Didn't he play at the Little Club? He played at the Little Club too and then he played at the Liberty Theater. You mentioned a few minutes ago, Chene, about the...
